value.rationale: The classical projective plane PG(2,3) is the next Desarguesian projective geometry beyond the Fano plane, and its full point-line order-ideal dynamics is a natural finite invariant of a highly symmetric, non-rectangular, non-minuscule poset. The seven irregular orbit lengths, exact order 6930 and reduction of 6202 dynamical cycles to 22 collineation symmetry types reveal structure inaccessible from generic rowmotion definitions. The 22-class table is a complete natural classification useful for testing proposed orbit-regularity and homomesy phenomena, not an arbitrary parameter slice or re-labeling. Finite scope is acknowledged and no downstream theorem is necessary for this precise structural fact.
